event: You restart your computer. The problem disappears without explanation.
Autocorrect changes the one word you actually spelled correctly.
You finally remember your password. The site makes you change it.
You click 'Remind Me Tomorrow' for three weeks.
You hold the door open. The person is much farther away than you thought.
You laugh at a joke before realizing it wasn't a joke.
You spend five minutes saying goodbye and then leave in the same direction.
You introduce two people. They already know each other.
You prepare for every question except the one they ask.
You fix an issue nobody reported. A different issue immediately appears.
You answer an email. It generates four more emails.
Friday's emergency becomes Monday's forgotten topic.
You check the forecast. The weather chooses a surprise option.
You wash your car. It rains that afternoon.
You finally decide not to buy something. Then it sells out.
The cashier opens a new lane right after you commit to a long line.
You take the first bite of pizza. All the cheese comes with it.
You save the best bite for last. It falls.
You microwave coffee for the third time.
Your suitcase arrives. Everyone else's looks exactly like it.
You remember something important the moment the plane takes off.
Your pet wakes you up to watch them sleep somewhere else.
You buy a luxury pet bed. The pet prefers the floor.
You step onto the escalator and almost trip despite years of experience.
You look at the time. Two minutes later you look again.
You put your phone down and immediately lose it.
You finally finish a chore you've been avoiding. It takes five minutes.
sourbert: The anticipation was the hard part.

event: You walk confidently into the wrong room.
You remember an embarrassing moment from seven years ago while trying to sleep.
You carefully carry everything in one trip and drop the last item.
You say 'you too' when the waiter says 'enjoy your meal.'
You start telling a story and realize halfway through everyone already heard it.
You confidently use someone's name. It isn't their name.
The Wi-Fi stops working five minutes before your meeting.
You finally fix the printer. It immediately invents a new problem.
Your software update finishes. Nothing looks different.
sourbert: The magic happened on the inside.

event: You type the perfect password. It was the wrong website.
You finish a project. A new requirement arrives thirty seconds later.
The meeting could have been an email. The email could have been nothing.
You proofread the document three times. The typo is in the title.
You pick the shortest security line. It becomes the longest.
The gate changes after you've found a comfortable seat.
You arrive early. Your flight is delayed anyway.
You bite into food expecting sweet. It turns out salty.
You heat up leftovers and they are somehow cold in the middle.
Your avocado skipped ripe and went directly to expired.
You walk into a room and instantly forget why.
You finally remember why you entered the room after you've left it.
You carefully avoid every puddle. A car drives by.
You put something somewhere safe.
sourbert: See you again in six months.

event: The item goes on sale the day after you buy it.
You finally choose a product. There are twelve more versions.
You bring an umbrella. No rain. You forget it once. Monsoon.
Your pet wants to go outside. Then immediately wants back in.
Your pet ignores the expensive toy and plays with the box.
